headline: Nahar Capital submits October 2026 demat report to the exchange
hook: Routine depository update from Nahar Capital
summary: Nahar Capital and Financial Services Limited has submitted its demat report for the month of October 2026 to the stock exchange. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing concerning depository participant data. No financial results or operational performance metrics were disclosed in this update. Indian retail investors holding this stock experience no immediate impact on valuation.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no direct impact on share price
